fusions.name: Parting Flick
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Break Cover
fusions.desc: Bursts out with the blade drawn, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Startle Reflex
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood and clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Stung Into Motion
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
